summary.zh: 魔杖单刷，双生戒律覆盖护盾与恢复，再经精神强化点到强化真言术：盾。
summary.en: Wand damage for solo kills, Twin Disciplines on your shields and Renew, then Mental Strength into Improved Power Word: Shield.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，既进本治疗，也要单刷任务
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, healing dungeons while still questing solo

pros.zh: 魔杖专精提供 25% 魔杖伤害，而 20 级之前魔杖正是你的主要伤害来源。
pros.en: Wand Specialization adds 25% wand damage, and wanding is most of your damage before level 20.

pros.zh: 双生戒律让瞬发法术的伤害和治疗提高 3%，同时覆盖恢复、真言术：盾与暗言术：痛。
pros.en: Twin Disciplines adds 3% to the damage and healing of your instant casts, which covers Renew, Power Word: Shield and Shadow Word: Pain at once.

pros.zh: 精神强化把智力提高 10%，并打开第 3 行，让强化真言术：盾的第一点就能多吸收 7% 伤害。
pros.en: Mental Strength raises Intellect by 10% and opens row 3 for Improved Power Word: Shield, which absorbs 7% more damage on your first shield talent point.

pros.zh: 想走神圣？在共用魔杖起手之后，把戒律护盾路线换成强化恢复与神圣系天赋。
pros.en: Playing Holy instead? Spend the Discipline shield path on Improved Renew and Holy specialization talents once you leave the shared wand opener.

pros.zh: 如果法力从来不是问题，最后 1 点可以点冥想而不是护盾。
pros.en: If Mana is never the problem, put the last point into Meditation instead of the shield.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
